rules: Controversial resources are excluded regardless of format, rights, provider or product.
Rights verification, relevance scores, root pages and EPUB export are not book evidence.
Each public book requires a reviewed work identity, creator or translation identity, edition/source evidence, complete-work status and scope review.
Uncertain content/type stays in a non-public review queue; no quantity target overrides admission.
Source topics mentioning ancient Israel/Palestine, biblical warfare or church history alone are not exclusion signals; assess primary purpose and period.
